scripts.deploy: node -e "process.env.CLOUDFLARE_ENV='production'; const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const run = (cmd, args) => { const result = spawnSync(cmd, args, { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true, env: process.env }); if (result.status) process.exit(result.status); }; run('npm', ['run', 'build']); run('wrangler', ['deploy', '--config', 'src/frontend/dist/pl8ypus_linkedin_scheduler_dev/wrangler.json', '--env', 'production']);"
scripts.deploy:staging: node -e "process.env.CLOUDFLARE_ENV='staging'; const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const run = (cmd, args) => { const result = spawnSync(cmd, args, { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true, env: process.env }); if (result.status) process.exit(result.status); }; run('npm', ['run', 'build']); run('wrangler', ['deploy', '--config', 'src/frontend/dist/pl8ypus_linkedin_scheduler_dev/wrangler.json', '--env', 'staging']);"
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply pl8ypus-scheduler-db-staging --remote --env staging
